name: Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi

main_effect:
[Trash] [Your Turn] When one of your level 6 Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text is played, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into this card.
[When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -16000 DP for the turn. If DNA digivolving, you may set the memory to 3 on the opponent's side. Then, if this Digimon has a Tamer in its digivolution cards, gain 1 memory and ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[When Attacking] By trashing the top card of your security stack, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
